notes.title: First big Umfend update is live!
Discord server and minor news
notes.content:
We opened a Discord server where you can report bugs, ask us some questions, discuss our games or simply talk. Let's see how it goes. 

[url=https://discord.gg/XUZAtQc ]Discord[/url]


Also, we updated the game with several fixes. Some bug fixes, now the "food" puzzle autocompletes after 3 failed attempts and we fixed the English script thanks for Rin Satsu who volunteered to correct mistakes.
